[Verse]
Oh, the river hums and every door is open
I left a light on, just in case you wandered home
we were paper boats until the morning came
the kitchen radio was humming low
my father's jacket on the door
we counted every mile, the county road
a summer storm, a paper crown
the diner coffee, Sunday afternoon
I left the porch light on
the window painted gold
we traded all our keys
